ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Text Information Management and Analysis Text data are rich in semantic content and often contain valuable information such as human opinions and preferences. Text mining is the process of converting big unstructured text data into actionable knowledge. CS 591txt is a seminar on current topics in the text mining field, which is closely related to data mining, machine learning, and natural language processing. We will interactively read, discuss, and analyze the latest research from top conferences while practicing our own presentation skills.
